subject: planner: refactor some code of Plan Cache (#57234)
summary: Reviewed commit diff vs first parent, limited to planner plan cache/clone code paths touched here. Changes are primarily refactors: instance plan cache lookup now clones the cached plan inline and returns (plan, output columns, stmt hints) separately; PointGet/BatchPointGet range rebuild logic is extracted into helpers and PointGet range rebuild now relies on plan SCtx after removing PointGetPlan.ctx; plan-cache clone helper functions are moved out of the generated file into plan_clone_utils.go and call sites updated (`, nil` allocator param), with no semantic changes observed. Looked specifically for correctness/SQL semantics, privilege checks, session/transaction context handling, and concurrency hazards around instance plan cache cloning + cached-plan rebuild; no plausible Blocker/High issues found. Also scanned later history (1770006..upstream/master) touching these files and saw no follow-up fix/revert suggesting a missed Blocker/High regression from this refactor.
